objective: Make the CPVS residual audit preserve out-of-parent candidate provenance without aborting TSV serialization or mislabeling those IDs as parent-scoped membership.
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #204 already separated raw g/r candidates from parent-scoped candidate membership and added a set-level regression test.
Code inspection found the TSV writer still raised ValueError for every residual target absent from Table 2 and assigned all non-candidate-only IDs the published_only relation.
The parent-scoped CPVS membership discrepancy remains scientifically unresolved; this change is diagnostic serialization only.

baseline.description: PR #204's candidate count is parent-scoped, but residual provenance output raises for out-of-parent IDs and relation labels do not distinguish them.

expected_improvement: Out-of-parent candidate IDs remain traceable in residual TSV with empty parent metadata.
Residual relation explicitly labels out-of-parent candidates.
Regression tests cover relation classification without changing scientific selection criteria.

correctness.before: TSV writer raises ValueError when a residual SourceID is absent from Table 2
correctness.after: Writer conditionally emits parent metadata and preserves out-of-parent residual rows; CI validation pending
correctness.evidence: scripts/audit_cpvs_residual_epochs.py and tests/test_cpvs_residual_epoch_audit.py on this branch

scientific_validity.before: 741,786 candidates; 730,184 published IDs; 11,602 candidate-only; 0 published-only (historical recorded result)
scientific_validity.after: Not changed by this diagnostic serialization fix
scientific_validity.evidence: Issue #170; values must be reverified by current source-backed run

evidence: Added explicit membership_relation helper and conditional parent metadata emission.
Added regression assertions for out-of-parent, candidate-only, and published-only relations.
GitHub CI and scientific-validation workflows are pending; no test pass is claimed yet.

root_causes: The audit target set intentionally includes raw candidate IDs outside the parent catalog, but TSV serialization incorrectly required every target to exist in that catalog.
The relation label was derived only from candidate_only membership, conflating outside-parent candidates with published-only objects.

findings: Parent-scoped membership counts and raw photometry provenance must be reported separately.
Absence from a parent catalog is a provenance category, not a reason to discard a candidate or abort the report.
A diagnostic serialization repair cannot resolve the scientific justification for the CPVS selection predicate.

open_blockers: Await CI and scientific-validation results for this branch.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not change CPVS selection thresholds, flags, or published-reference acceptance criteria to force count equality.
Keep issue #170 open until the published rule is justified by source/method evidence.
Do not merge this stacked diagnostic PR until checks and parent-branch relationship are reviewed.
